start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Board par dekho: Kabir, triangle ko aise sochiye: teen sides milkar ek band shape banati hain. Perimeter ke liye kya karenge?

turns.line: board par rectangle ka perimeter samjhao
turns.reply: Board par rectangle dekhiye: perimeter matlab chaaron sides ki total length. Length aur breadth ko jodkar do baar kyun lenge?
